var_panniyur_1.name: Panniyur-1
var_panniyur_1.specialities: World's first hybrid pepper; features long spikes and very high yield.
var_panniyur_1.suitabilityReason: Vigorous grower that thrives in open areas with high humidity.

var_kuching.name: Kuching
var_kuching.specialities: High piperine content and excellent dry-to-green recovery ratio.
var_kuching.suitabilityReason: More tolerant to adverse conditions and reliable in drier zones.
var_kuching.soilTypeRecommendation: Thrives in sandy loam or well-drained gravelly soil.

var_gk_49.name: GK 49
var_gk_49.specialities: A high-yielding local selection with very high pungency.
var_gk_49.suitabilityReason: Highly adaptable to Sri Lankan local conditions and pest resistant.
var_gk_49.soilTypeRecommendation: Adapts well to Red-Yellow Podzolic soils.

var_iw_5.name: IW 5
var_iw_5.specialities: Features a high growth rate during early establishment and stable yields.

var_local.name: Local
var_local.specialities: Traditional Sri Lankan pepper variety with stable yield and strong adaptability.
var_local.suitabilityReason: Naturally adapted to local climatic and soil conditions with minimal input requirements.
var_local.soilTypeRecommendation: Grows well in a wide range of soils with good drainage.
